question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and key state institutions underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against removal before 2027. No visible factional challenges, health issues, or policy ruptures have emerged in 2025–2026, while recent appointments and continuity ahead of the 21st Party Congress in 2027 follow the pattern of leadership changes occurring at scheduled party meetings. Elite politics in Beijing stay opaque by design, yet historical precedents and the lack of organized opposition sustain this pricing. Low-probability shifts could still stem from an abrupt medical event, severe economic pressures triggering elite realignment, or an unforeseen external shock disrupting internal dynamics before December 2026.
